status: open follow-up for next security checkpoint; Array.from local path separately precharged
finding: Shared Runtime::own_keys charges sorting/dedup work by key count/log count, but inserts complete retained UTF-16 JsString names into a BTreeSet. Derived string ordering can inspect arbitrarily long common prefixes, whose length-dependent comparison work is not precharged.

core_evidence.detail: Key-byte totals contribute to allocation allowance only. Work is count/log based before keys.retain(|key| seen.insert(key.clone())).
Ordering is lexicographic on Rc<[u16]>, rather than constant-time interned key identity.

public_entries.coverage: Generic native precharge counts string arguments or dense array contents, not stored ordinary-object names; later key ticks cannot precharge already completed dedup.
Wrapper adds count work/vector allocation after the shared enumeration.
No full-name comparison precharge before descriptor-key enumeration.

public_entries.entry: Array length assignment or Object.defineProperty length shrink
public_entries.coverage: Shared non-Array.from paths lack the new Array.from-specific preflight.
Snapshot happens before the per-key traversal work.

separate_paths_not_affected_by_this_find: Object seal/freeze/isSealed/isFrozen use integrity_keys with precharged numeric/index/ordinal sort, avoiding full-name dedup.
Window enumeration diverts to window_own_keys and precharges key bytes plus numeric/global-order sorting without full-name dedup.
Object.getOwnPropertySymbols uses own_symbol_keys directly, not own_keys.
independent_future_budget_case: Prepare equal-size ordinary objects with short versus 512-unit common-prefix names before the measured call; retain identical key count and semantic ordering. With a narrowly sufficient remaining instruction budget, verify that full-name comparison work is prepaid before key snapshot/sort/dedup and that shortage cannot mutate the receiver. Freeze expected accounting invariants before implementation; include each public entry and cumulative calls.
risk_scope: An instruction-ledger coverage gap, not a proven panic or unbounded allocation. Existing overall heap/work caps still apply; no candidate engine measurements were performed for this finding.
current_slice_resolution: Array.from array_from_shrink_budget precharges actual retained string lengths, dedup depth, dense enumeration, deletion scans and scratch before its final Set; no shared helper rewrite in this feature slice.
root_disposition: Retain for next security checkpoint and disclose open accounting gap in docs/SECURITY.md; do not broaden current frozen feature comparison.
